column3: One morning, you simply open your eyes.
Every fall feels like the end of the world.
and you learn the oldest trick there is.
You ask questions no one can answer. You fall in love.
then the world hands you a hard hat and a heavy load.
Some days you just want to sleep.
someone's small reaches for your hand.
and suddenly you understand what it was all for.
the people you love begin to leave.
You don't carry as much anymore. You don't need to.
In the end, a life isn't measured in years.
It's measured in the moments you were truly there.
A new morning is just beginning.
